title: Researchers are getting tired of OpenAI gatekeeping its breakthroughs
summary: On Monday, OpenAI announced impressive breakthroughs in mathematics, computer science, and physics, along with what the company says is an evolving approach to communicating its findings. But despite its apparent course correction, researchers who spoke to The Verge are growing increasingly tired of the company's antics. It has been a turbulent few months between OpenAI […]
llm_summary: OpenAI recently unveiled a series of breakthroughs in mathematics, computer science and physics, saying it will adopt a more flexible, “evolving” way of sharing its research. However, many researchers say the company’s habit of tightly controlling access to its findings—often withholding details or limiting who can see the work—has become increasingly frustrating. While OpenAI claims it’s shifting its approach, the community remains skeptical that the gatekeeping will truly ease.
